metadata.description: Independent Google and YouTube data tasks, plus the combined FlashData research plugin.

plugins.name: flashdata
plugins.description: Research the web and YouTube with FlashData MCP, source links, transcript timestamps, and reusable research skills.

plugins.name: google-search-flashdata
plugins.description: Search Google and return ranked page titles, URLs, snippets and positions as JSON. Uses FlashData.

plugins.name: google-news-flashdata
plugins.description: Search Google News and return headlines, publishers, date labels and article links as JSON. Uses FlashData.

plugins.name: google-images-flashdata
plugins.description: Search Google Images and return image URLs, dimensions and source-page links as JSON. Uses FlashData.

plugins.name: google-shopping-flashdata
plugins.description: Search Google Shopping and return product offers, merchants and displayed prices as JSON. Uses FlashData.

plugins.name: google-video-search-flashdata
plugins.description: Search Google Videos across websites and return video titles, links, sources and available durations as JSON. Uses FlashData.

plugins.name: google-places-flashdata
plugins.description: Find local businesses and places with addresses, ratings and available review counts as JSON. Uses FlashData.

plugins.name: youtube-search-flashdata
plugins.description: Search YouTube with keyword, date, duration and sorting filters. Request up to 20 video results. Uses FlashData.

plugins.name: youtube-extended-search-flashdata
plugins.description: Search YouTube with filters and up to 700 requested results, returned as structured video records. Uses FlashData.

plugins.name: youtube-metadata-flashdata
plugins.description: Get YouTube video details, descriptions, statistics and available chapters or formats as JSON. Uses FlashData.

plugins.name: youtube-transcript-flashdata
plugins.description: Get existing YouTube transcripts with timed segments. Selects automatic captions by default. Uses FlashData.

plugins.name: youtube-captions-flashdata
plugins.description: Get existing YouTube captions with timed segments. Selects uploader-provided captions by default. Uses FlashData.

plugins.name: youtube-trainability-flashdata
plugins.description: Read a YouTube video’s Creative Commons license-label metadata as JSON. Uses FlashData.

plugins.name: youtube-channel-flashdata
plugins.description: Get a YouTube channel profile and recent videos by handle, with up to 100 requested videos. Uses FlashData.

plugins.name: youtube-autocomplete-flashdata
plugins.description: Get YouTube autocomplete phrases for a search prefix, language and region. Uses FlashData.

plugins.name: youtube-cloud-storage-flashdata
plugins.description: Download YouTube video, audio or clips to your own S3 or other supported cloud storage. Uses FlashData.
